shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone face
justification: Both surfaces show relief carving applied to upright architectural stonework, but that is a generic correspondence: A carries a single schematic quadruped in shallow relief on a plain monolithic pillar, while B carries a continuous horizontal frieze of repeated, naturalistically detailed standing human figures in profile beneath fluted columns and a monumental stair. The depicted subjects (animal vs. human procession), the density and repetition of figures, and the rendering conventions are entirely different.
